units.zh: 仁宗敬天體道純誠至德弘文欽武章聖達孝昭皇帝，諱高熾，成祖長子也。
units.en: Emperor Renzong—honored after death as one who revered Heaven, embodied the Way, and united pure sincerity, supreme virtue, literary cultivation, martial achievement, sagely wisdom, and filial devotion—was named Gaochi and was the eldest son of the Chengzu Emperor.
units.literal: The Renzong Emperor, revering Heaven and embodying the Way, pure and sincere in utmost virtue, cultured in literature and martial in achievement, sagely and filially accomplished, taboo name Gaochi, was Chengzu's eldest son.

units.zh: 母仁孝文皇后，夢冠冕執圭者上謁。
units.en: His mother, the Empress of Benevolent Filiality and Culture, dreamed of a figure in court robes and cap bearing a jade tablet who bowed before her.
units.literal: His mother was the Empress of Benevolent Filiality and Culture; she dreamed of one in cap and regalia holding a jade tablet who came to pay homage.

units.zh: 寤而生帝。
units.en: When she awoke she gave birth to the future emperor.
units.literal: On waking she bore the emperor.

units.zh: 幼端重沉靜，言動有經。
units.en: As a boy he was grave and composed, his words and actions always measured.
units.literal: In youth he was dignified, weighty, and calm; speech and conduct had constant measure.

units.zh: 稍長習射，發無不中。
units.en: As he grew he trained in archery and never missed his mark.
units.literal: When grown a little he practiced archery; every shot struck.

units.zh: 好學問，從儒臣講論不輟。
units.en: He delighted in scholarship and debated unceasingly with the scholar-officials.
units.literal: He loved learning; with Confucian ministers he discussed without ceasing.

units.zh: 洪武二十八年，冊為燕世子。
units.en: In Hongwu year twenty-eight he was installed as heir apparent of the Yan princedom.
units.literal: In the twenty-eighth year of Hongwu he was enfeoffed as Heir of Yan.

units.zh: 嘗命與秦、晉、周三世子分閱衛士，還獨後。
units.en: On one occasion he and the crown princes of Qin, Jin, and Zhou were sent to inspect the guards by turns; he alone came back last.
units.literal: Once he was ordered with the heirs of Qin, Jin, and Zhou to inspect guards in turn; returning, he alone was last.

units.zh: 問之。
units.en: The emperor asked why.
units.literal: He was questioned about it.

units.zh: 對曰：「旦寒甚，俟朝食而後閱，故後。」
units.en: He replied: "The morning was bitterly cold; I waited until after breakfast to make the inspection, and so returned late."
units.literal: He answered: "At dawn it was very cold; I waited for the morning meal and then inspected, therefore late."

units.zh: 又命分閱章奏，獨取切軍民利病者白之。
units.en: He was also set to review memorials by turns, but singled out only those bearing on the people's hardships and presented them himself.
units.literal: Again he was ordered to review memorials in turn; alone he took those touching on civilian and military welfare and reported them.

units.zh: 或文字謬誤，不以聞。
units.en: When a document contained clerical errors he did not bring it forward.
units.literal: At times when the writing had mistakes he did not report them.

units.zh: 太祖指示之曰：「兒忽之耶？」
units.en: The founding emperor indicated them and asked: "My boy, are you overlooking these?"
units.literal: The Taizu Emperor pointed and said: "Son, do you disregard them?"

units.zh: 對曰：「不敢忽，顧小過不足瀆天聽。」
units.en: He answered: "I do not disregard them; trivial slips are not worth burdening Your Majesty's ear."
units.literal: He answered: "I dare not disregard; only small faults are unworthy to trouble Heaven's hearing."

units.zh: 又嘗問：「堯、湯時水旱，百姓奚恃？」
units.en: On another occasion he was asked: "When flood or drought struck in the age of Yao and Tang, what did the people trust?"
units.literal: Again he was once asked: "In the times of Yao and Tang there were flood and drought—on what did the people rely?"

units.zh: 對曰：「恃聖人有恤民之政。」
units.en: He replied: "On the sage-rulers' policies of compassion for the people."
units.literal: He answered: "They relied on the sages having policies that comforted the people."

units.zh: 太祖喜曰：「孫有君人之識矣！」
units.en: The founding emperor was pleased: "The lad already thinks like a sovereign!"
units.literal: The Taizu Emperor rejoiced and said: "The grandson has a ruler's understanding!"

units.zh: 成祖舉兵，世子守北平，善拊士卒，以萬人拒李景隆五十萬眾，城賴以全。
units.en: During Chengzu's uprising the heir held Beiping, won the troops' hearts, and with ten thousand men held off Li Jinglong's army of five hundred thousand, saving the city.
units.literal: When Chengzu raised arms, the heir defended Beiping, good at comforting soldiers; with ten thousand he resisted Li Jinglong's five hundred thousand host, and the city was preserved thereby.

units.zh: 先是，郡王高煦、高燧俱以慧黠有寵於成祖。
units.en: Earlier, his younger brothers the princes Gao Xu and Gao Sui had both won Chengzu's affection through quick wit.
units.literal: Before this, the princes Gao Xu and Gao Sui both by cleverness had Chengzu's favor.

units.zh: 而高煦從軍有功，宦寺黃儼等復党高燧，陰謀奪嫡，譖世子。
units.en: Gao Xu had campaigned with distinction; the eunuch Huang Yan and his faction backed Gao Sui, scheming in secret to supplant the heir and traducing him at court.
units.literal: Gao Xu moreover had merit following the army; eunuch Huang Yan and others again sided with Gao Sui, secretly plotting to seize the succession and slandering the heir.

units.zh: 會朝廷賜世子書，為離間。
units.en: Once the central government sent the heir a letter intended to drive a wedge between father and son.
units.literal: It happened that the court sent the heir a letter meant to sow division.

units.zh: 世子不啟緘，馳上之。
units.en: The heir never broke the seal but raced to deliver the packet intact to Chengzu.
units.literal: The heir did not break the seal; he galloped to present it unopened.

units.zh: 而儼先潛報成祖曰：「世子與朝廷通，使者至矣。」
units.en: Huang Yan had already whispered to Chengzu, "The heir is in league with the court—the envoy has arrived."
units.literal: Yet Yan first secretly reported to Chengzu: "The heir communicates with the court—the messenger has arrived."

units.zh: 無何，世子所遣使亦至。
units.en: Soon the heir's own messenger reached camp as well.
units.literal: Before long, the envoy the heir had sent also arrived.

units.zh: 成祖發書視之，乃歎曰：「幾殺吾子。」
units.en: Chengzu opened the letter and groaned: "I was within a hair's breadth of destroying my own son."
units.literal: Chengzu broke the seal and viewed the letter, then sighed: "I nearly killed my son."

units.zh: 成祖踐阼，以北平為北京，仍命居守。
units.en: When Chengzu took the throne he made Beiping the Northern Capital but still left the heir in charge there.
units.literal: Chengzu ascended the throne; Beiping was made Beijing, yet he was still ordered to remain and guard.

units.zh: 永樂二年二月，始召至京，立為皇太子。
units.en: In the second month of Yongle 2 he was at last called to the capital and invested as crown prince.
units.literal: In the second month of Yongle year two he was first summoned to the capital and installed as crown prince.

units.zh: 成祖數北征，命之監國，裁決庶政。
units.en: Chengzu marched north again and again, leaving him to govern and decide the daily business of rule.
units.literal: Chengzu repeatedly campaigned north and ordered him to oversee the state, deciding common affairs.

units.zh: 四方水旱饑饉，輒遣振恤，仁聞大著。
units.en: Whenever flood, drought, or famine struck any quarter he dispatched relief, and his reputation for benevolence spread far.
units.literal: In the four quarters flood, drought, and famine—he promptly sent relief; his benevolence became greatly renowned.

units.zh: 而高煦、高燧與其黨日伺隙讒構。
units.en: Gao Xu, Gao Sui, and their clique meanwhile looked daily for chances to intrigue against him.
units.literal: Yet Gao Xu, Gao Sui, and their faction daily watched for openings to slander and intrigue.

units.zh: 或問太子：「亦知有讒人乎？」
units.en: Once someone asked the heir apparent: "Do you know there are men working to ruin you?"
units.literal: Someone asked the crown prince: "Do you also know there are slanderers?"

units.zh: 曰：「不知也，吾知盡子職而已。」
units.en: He answered: "I pay them no mind; I know only how to discharge a son's obligations."
units.literal: He said: "I do not know; I only know to fulfill a son's duty."

units.zh: 十年，北征還，以太子遣使後期，且書奏失辭，悉徵宮僚黃儼等下獄。
units.en: In Yongle 10, on returning from the north, Chengzu blamed the heir's late dispatch of envoys and lapses in memorial wording and threw Huang Yan and the rest of the household staff into prison.
units.literal: In year ten, returning from the northern campaign, because the prince's envoy was late and memorials had improper wording, all palace staff including Huang Yan were summoned and imprisoned.

units.zh: 十五年，高煦以罪徙樂安。
units.en: In year fifteen Gao Xu was punished and transferred to Le'an.
units.literal: In year fifteen Gao Xu was banished to Le'an for crime.

units.zh: 明年，黃儼等復譖太子擅赦罪人，宮僚多坐死者。
units.en: The following year Huang Yan's party accused the heir of unauthorized amnesties, and many of his attendants were executed.
units.literal: The next year Huang Yan and others again slandered the crown prince for pardoning criminals on his own authority; many palace staff were punished with death.

units.zh: 侍郎胡濙奉命察之，密疏太子誠敬孝謹七事以聞，成祖意乃釋。
units.en: Vice Minister Hu Ying was sent to inquire and privately reported seven proofs of the heir's loyalty, respect, filial piety, and restraint; Chengzu's suspicions eased.
units.literal: Vice Minister Hu Ying was ordered to investigate; he secretly memorialized seven matters of the prince's sincerity, reverence, filiality, and prudence, and Chengzu's mind was released.

units.zh: 其後黃儼等謀立高燧，事覺伏誅，高燧以太子力解得免，自是太子始安。
units.en: Later Huang Yan's group tried to place Gao Sui on the throne; the plot was uncovered and they were put to death; Gao Sui was spared only because the heir pleaded for him, and at last the crown prince could rest secure.
units.literal: Thereafter Huang Yan and others plotted to install Gao Sui; the affair was exposed and they were executed; Gao Sui was spared through the crown prince's earnest intercession—only then did the heir begin to be secure.

units.zh: 二十二年七月，成祖崩於榆木川。
units.en: In the seventh month of Yongle 22 Chengzu died at Yumu River.
units.literal: In the seventh month of year twenty-two Chengzu died at Yumu River.

units.zh: 八月甲辰，遺詔至，遣皇太孫迎喪開平。
units.en: In the eighth month on jiachen the death testament reached the capital and the imperial great-grandson was sent to meet the bier at Kaiping.
units.literal: In the eighth month on jiachen the final edict arrived; the imperial great-grandson was dispatched to receive the coffin at Kaiping.

units.zh: 丁未，出夏原吉等於獄。
units.en: On dingwei Xia Yuanji and the others were freed from custody.
units.literal: On dingwei Xia Yuanji and others were released from prison.

units.zh: 丁巳，即皇帝位。
units.en: On dingsi he ascended the throne.
units.literal: On dingsi he assumed the imperial throne.

units.zh: 大赦天下，以明年為洪熙元年。
units.en: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the coming year was declared the first year of the Hongxi reign.
units.literal: Great pardon under Heaven; the coming year was made the first year of Hongxi.

units.zh: 罷西洋寶船、迤西市馬及雲南、交阯採辦。
units.en: The western treasure voyages, the Yili horse fairs, and the procurement offices in Yunnan and Jiaozhi were abolished.
units.literal: Western treasure fleets, Yili horse markets, and procurement in Yunnan and Jiaozhi were abolished.

units.zh: 戊午，復夏原吉、吳中官。
units.en: On wuwu Xia Yuanji and Wu Zhong were reinstated.
units.literal: On wuwu Xia Yuanji and Wu Zhong were restored to office.

units.zh: 己未，武安侯鄭亨鎮大同，保定侯孟瑛鎮交阯，襄城伯李隆鎮山海，武進伯朱榮鎮遼東。
units.en: On jiwei Wu'an Marquis Zheng Heng took command at Datong, Baoding Marquis Meng Ying at Jiaozhi, Xiangcheng Earl Li Long at Shanhaiguan, and Wujin Baron Zhu Rong in Liaodong.
units.literal: On jiwei Zheng Heng Marquis of Wu'an garrisoned Datong, Meng Ying Marquis of Baoding Jiaozhi, Li Long Earl of Xiangcheng the Shanhai pass, Zhu Rong Baron of Wujin Liaodong.

units.zh: 復設三公、三孤官，以公、侯、伯、尚書兼之。
units.en: The grand titles of the Three Dukes and Three Preceptors were revived, to be filled by nobles and ministers in joint appointment.
units.literal: The offices of Three Dukes and Three Preceptors were restored, held concurrently by dukes, marquises, earls, and ministers.

units.zh: 進楊榮太常寺卿，金幼孜戶部侍郎，兼大學士如故，楊士奇為禮部左侍郎兼華蓋殿大學士，黃淮通政使兼武英殿大學士，俱掌內制，楊溥為翰林學士。
units.en: Yang Rong was made Minister of Imperial Sacrifices, Jin Youzi Vice Minister of Revenue, both retaining their grand secretary posts; Yang Shiqi became Left Vice Minister of Rites and Grand Secretary of Huagai Hall; Huang Huai Commissioner of the Transmission Office and Grand Secretary of Wuying Hall, all drafting imperial orders; Yang Pu was appointed Hanlin Academician.
units.literal: Yang Rong promoted to Minister of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, Jin Youzi Vice Minister of Revenue, all Grand Secretaries as before; Yang Shiqi Minister of Rites left and Grand Secretary of Huagai Hall; Huang Huai Commissioner of the Transmission Office and Grand Secretary of Wuying Hall—all handling inner drafts; Yang Pu made Hanlin Academician.

units.zh: 辛酉，鎮遠侯顧興祖充總兵官，討廣西叛蠻。
units.en: On xinyou Zhenyuan Marquis Gu Xingzu was appointed supreme commander to quell rebellious Man in Guangxi.
units.literal: On xinyou Gu Xingzu Marquis of Zhenyuan was made supreme commander to suppress rebel tribes in Guangxi.

units.zh: 甲子，汰冗官。
units.en: On jiazi redundant offices were cut.
units.literal: On jiazi superfluous officials were culled.

units.zh: 乙丑，召漢王高煦赴京。
units.en: On yichou the Prince of Han, Gao Xu, was ordered to come to court.
units.literal: On yichou the Prince of Han Gao Xu was summoned to the capital.

units.zh: 戊辰，官吏謫隸軍籍者放還鄉。
units.en: On wuchen officials who had been demoted to soldier rolls were allowed to return to their villages.
units.literal: On wuchen officials banished to military registers were sent home.

units.zh: 己巳，詔文臣年七十致仕。
units.en: On jisi an edict required civil officials to retire at seventy.
units.literal: On jisi an edict fixed retirement at seventy for civil officials.

units.zh: 九月癸酉，交阯都指揮方政與黎利戰於茶籠州，敗績，指揮同知伍雲力戰死。
units.en: In the ninth month on guiyou Fang Zheng, regional commander in Jiaozhi, met Li Lei at Chalong and was beaten; Assistant Commander Wu Yun died in fierce combat.
units.literal: In the ninth month on guiyou Fang Zheng regional commander of Jiaozhi fought Li Lei at Chalong Prefecture and was defeated; Assistant Commander Wu Yun died fighting stubbornly.

units.zh: 丙子，召尚書黃福於交阯。
units.en: On bingzi Minister Huang Fu was recalled from Annam.
units.literal: On bingzi Minister Huang Fu was recalled from Jiaozhi.

units.zh: 庚辰，河溢開封，免稅糧，遣右都御史王彰撫恤之。
units.en: On gengchen floods from the Yellow River inundated Kaifeng; taxes in grain were waived and Right Censor-in-chief Wang Zhang was dispatched to relieve the district.
units.literal: On gengchen the Yellow River burst its banks at Kaifeng; grain taxes were remitted and Censor-in-chief Wang Zhang was sent to comfort the people.

units.zh: 壬午，敕自今官司所用物料於所產地計直市之，科派病民者罪不宥。
units.en: On renwu an edict required all government supplies to be bought at market rates in the localities where they were produced; officials who still levied burdens on the people would not be spared.
units.literal: On renwu an edict: from now materials used by government offices shall be purchased at fair value where produced—those who injure the people by corvée levies shall not be pardoned.

units.zh: 癸未，禮部尚書呂震請除服，不許。
units.en: On guwei Minister of Rites Lü Zhen asked permission to leave off mourning garb; the request was denied.
units.literal: On guwei Minister of Rites Lü Zhen petitioned to end mourning dress; not permitted.

units.zh: 乙酉，增諸王歲祿。
units.en: On yiyou the yearly allotments of the imperial princes were raised.
units.literal: On yiyou the annual stipends of princes were increased.

units.zh: 丙戌，以風憲官備外任，命給事中蕭奇等三十五人為州縣官。
units.en: On bingxu, to fill outer posts with men of integrity, thirty-five supervising secretaries led by Xiao Qi were made prefectural and county officials.
units.literal: On bingxu, because surveillance officials were needed in outside posts, thirty-five supervising secretaries including Xiao Qi were appointed district magistrates.

units.zh: 丁亥，黎利寇清化，指揮同知陳忠戰死。
units.en: On dinghai Li Lei attacked Thanh Hoa and Assistant Commander Chen Zhong fell fighting.
units.literal: On dinghai Li Lei raided Thanh Hoa; Assistant Commander Chen Zhong died in battle.

units.zh: 戊子，始設南京守備，以襄城伯李隆為之。
units.en: On wuzi the Nanjing defense command was established for the first time under Xiangcheng Earl Li Long.
units.literal: On wuzi the Nanjing garrison command was first established, with Li Long Earl of Xiangcheng as commander.

units.zh: 乙未，散畿內民所養官馬於諸衛所。
units.en: On yiwei government horses kept by civilians in the metropolitan districts were turned over to the guards.
units.literal: On yiwei commoners' official horses within the capital region were distributed among guard units.

units.zh: 戊戌，賜吏部尚書蹇義及楊士奇、楊榮、金幼孜銀章各一，曰「繩愆糾繆」，諭以協心贊務，凡有闕失當言者，用印密封以聞。
units.en: On wuxu Personnel Minister Jian Yi plus Yang Shiqi, Yang Rong, and Jin Youzi received silver seals inscribed "Correct errors and amend faults," with orders to work as one and seal confidential memorials whenever they found fault.
units.literal: On wuxu Minister of Personnel Jian Yi and Yang Shiqi, Yang Rong, Jin Youzi were each given a silver seal reading "Correct errors and rectify mistakes," told to assist in concert and to report shortcomings sealed under the seal.

units.zh: 冬十月壬寅，罷市民間金銀，革兩京戶部行用庫。
units.en: In the tenth month of winter on renyin the people were forbidden to hoard gold and silver, and the exchange depots of the two capitals were shut.
units.literal: Winter, tenth month, on renyin private possession of gold and silver in the populace was banned; the two capitals' circulating treasuries in the Revenue Ministry were abolished.

units.zh: 癸卯，詔天下都司衛所修治城池。
units.en: On guimao orders went out for every regional command and guard to repair its fortifications.
units.literal: On guimao an edict that military commissions and guards throughout the empire repair city walls.

units.zh: 戊申，通政使請以四方雨澤章奏送給事中收貯。
units.en: On wushen the Transmission Office proposed that reports on rain from all quarters be filed with the supervising secretaries.
units.literal: On wushen the Transmission Office asked to hand rainfall reports to supervising secretaries for storage.

units.zh: 帝曰：「祖宗令天下奏雨澤，欲知水旱，以施恤民之政。
units.en: The emperor replied: "Our forefathers required rainfall memorials from across the realm precisely so the throne could learn of flood and drought and send relief.
units.literal: The emperor said: "The ancestors ordered reports on rain throughout the empire in order to know flood and drought and apply policies that comfort the people.

units.zh: 積之通政司，既失之矣，今又令收貯，是欲上之人終不知也。
units.en: Letting them pile up in the Transmission Office was already a betrayal of that purpose; warehousing them again would ensure those above never knew the people's plight.
units.literal: To hoard them in the Transmission Office already misses the point; to store them further is to keep the sovereign forever ignorant.

units.zh: 自今奏至即以聞。」
units.en: Henceforth whenever such a memorial arrives, it must be brought to me immediately."
units.literal: From now when reports arrive report them at once."

units.zh: 己酉，冊妃張氏為皇后。
units.en: On jiyou Consort Zhang was enthroned as empress.
units.literal: On jiyou Consort Zhang was invested as empress.

units.zh: 壬子，立長子瞻基為皇太子。
units.en: On renzi the eldest son Zhanji was named heir apparent.
units.literal: On renzi the eldest son Zhanji was installed as crown prince.

units.zh: 封子瞻埈為鄭五，瞻墉越王，瞻墡襄王，瞻堈荊王，瞻墺淮王，瞻塏滕王，瞻垍梁王，瞻埏衛王。
units.en: His sons received princely titles: Zhanjun as Prince of Zheng, Zhanjiong of Yue, Zhanfan of Xiang, Zhanjian of Jing, Zhan'ao of Huai, Zhankai of Teng, Zhanji of Liang, and Zhanyan of Wei.
units.literal: Sons were enfeoffed: Zhanjun Prince of Zheng, Zhanjiong Prince of Yue, Zhanfan Prince of Xiang, Zhanjian Prince of Jing, Zhan'ao Prince of Huai, Zhankai Prince of Teng, Zhanji Prince of Liang, Zhanyan Prince of Wei.

units.zh: 乙卯，詔中外官舉賢才，嚴舉主連坐法。
units.en: On yimao an edict called on officials throughout the empire to nominate worthy men, with severe joint punishment for false nominations.
units.literal: On yimao an edict that civil and military officials inside and outside recommend the worthy; strict law of joint liability on the recommender.

units.zh: 丁巳，令三法司會大學士、府、部、通政、六科於承天門錄囚，著為令。
units.en: On dingsi the Three Judicial Offices, the grand secretaries, the ministries, the Transmission Office, and the six supervising offices were commanded to joint prisoner review at Chengtian Gate, and this was made permanent law.
units.literal: On dingsi the Three Judicial Offices, Grand Secretaries, the ministries, Transmission Office, and Six Offices of Scrutiny were ordered to review prisoners at Chengtian Gate—made standing regulation.

units.zh: 庚申，增京官及軍士月廩。
units.en: On gengshen the monthly grain rations of capital officials and troops were raised.
units.literal: On gengshen monthly rations of capital officials and soldiers were increased.

units.zh: 丁卯，擢監生徐永潛等二十人為給事中。
units.en: On dingmao twenty students led by Xu Yongqian were elevated to supervising secretaries.
units.literal: On dingmao twenty students including Xu Yongqian were promoted to supervising secretaries.

units.zh: 十一月壬申朔，詔禮部：「建文諸臣家屬在教坊司、錦衣衛、浣衣局及習匠、功臣家為奴者，悉宥為民，還其田土。
units.en: On the new moon of the eleventh month on renshen the Ministry of Rites was ordered: "Free to common status the kin of Jianwen loyalists held in the music school, Embroidered Uniform Guard, laundry offices, artisan registers, and merit-holders' households, and restore their fields.
units.literal: Eleventh month, renshen new moon, edict to the Ministry of Rites: "Families of Jianwen ministers in the music bureau, Embroidered Uniform Guard, laundry bureau, artisan training, and enslaved in merit houses—all pardoned to commoner status and land restored.

units.zh: 言事謫戍者亦如之。」
units.en: Those exiled for remonstrance received the same mercy."
units.literal: Those banished for memorializing were treated the same."

units.zh: 癸酉，詔有司：「條政令之不便民者以聞，凡被災不即請振者，罪之。」
units.en: On guiyou local authorities were told: "Report any policy that harms the people; officials who fail to request relief after disaster will be prosecuted."
units.literal: On guiyou an edict to local offices: "Report inconvenient policies to the throne; all who suffer disaster and do not promptly seek relief shall be punished."

units.zh: 阿魯台來貢馬。
units.en: Arugtai presented horses in tribute.
units.literal: Arugtai came to offer horses as tribute.

units.zh: 甲戌，詔羣臣言時政闕失。
units.en: On jiaxu the court was ordered to speak frankly of governmental faults.
units.literal: On jiaxu an edict that the assembled ministers speak of current failures in government.

units.zh: 乙亥，赦兀良哈罪。
units.en: On yihai the Uriangkhai tribes were forgiven their offenses.
units.literal: On yihai pardon for the crime of Urianghai.

units.zh: 始命近畿諸衛官軍更番詣京師操練。
units.en: For the first time nearby guard garrisons were put on rotating duty at the capital for training.
units.literal: First order that guard troops of the near capital districts rotate to the capital for drill.

units.zh: 丙子，遣御史巡察邊衛。
units.en: On bingzi censors were sent to tour the frontier garrisons.
units.literal: On bingzi censors were dispatched to inspect border guards.

units.zh: 癸未，遣御史分巡天下，考察官吏。
units.en: On guwei censors were sent on circuit tours to examine officials empire-wide.
units.literal: On guwei censors were dispatched in separate circuits to inspect officials throughout the empire.

units.zh: 丙戌，賜戶部尚書夏原吉「繩愆糾繆」銀章。
units.en: On bingxu Revenue Minister Xia Yuanji received the same "Correct errors and amend faults" silver seal.
units.literal: On bingxu Minister of Revenue Xia Yuanji was given the "Correct errors" silver seal.

units.zh: 己丑，禮部奏冬至節請受賀，不許。
units.en: On jichou the Ministry of Rites asked to hold the winter solstice congratulatory audience; it was refused.
units.literal: On jichou the Ministry of Rites memorialized the winter solstice requesting acceptance of congratulations; not permitted.

units.zh: 庚寅，敕諸將嚴邊備。
units.en: On gengyin frontier commanders were ordered to harden their defenses.
units.literal: On gengyin orders to generals to tighten border defense.

units.zh: 辛卯，禁所司擅役屯田軍士。
units.en: On xinmao agencies were forbidden to press garrison troops on state farms into corvée without authorization.
units.literal: On xinmao forbidden that offices arbitrarily conscript garrison soldiers on military colonies.

units.zh: 壬辰，都督方政同榮昌伯陳智鎮交阯。
units.en: On renchen Commander Fang Zheng and Rongchang Baron Chen Zhi took joint command in Jiaozhi.
units.literal: On renchen Regional Commander Fang Zheng with Baron Chen Zhi of Rongchang garrisoned Jiaozhi.

units.zh: 是月，諭蹇義、楊士奇、夏原吉、楊榮、金幼孜曰：「前世人主，或自尊大，惡聞直言，臣下相與阿附，以至於敗。
units.en: That month he told Jian Yi, Yang Shiqi, Xia Yuanji, Yang Rong, and Jin Youzi: "Some earlier rulers grew arrogant and shunned blunt counsel; their ministers flattered one another until the state collapsed.
units.literal: That month, he instructed Jian Yi, Yang Shiqi, Xia Yuanji, Yang Rong, Jin Youzi: "Former sovereigns, some self-important, hated to hear straight words; ministers fawned upon one another, until ruin.

units.zh: 朕與卿等當用為戒。」
units.en: I and you all must take that as our warning."
units.literal: I with you all should take this as warning."

units.zh: 又諭士奇曰：「頃羣臣頗懷忠愛，朕有過方自悔，而進言者已至，良愜朕心。」
units.en: He added to Shiqi: "Of late you ministers have shown genuine devotion; I was still reproaching myself when your remonstrances came, and that is exactly what pleases me."
units.literal: Again he instructed Shiqi: "Lately the ministers have shown real loyalty; when I had faults I was already repenting when remonstrance arrived—that greatly eases my mind."

units.zh: 十二月癸卯，宥建文諸臣外親全家戍邊者，留一人，餘悉放還。
units.en: In the twelfth month on guimao the outer kin of Jianwen officials who had been banished as whole clans were pardoned—one member was kept at the frontier, the rest released home.
units.literal: Twelfth month, on guimao, pardoned collateral kin of Jianwen ministers exiled as a whole family to the borders—one person was left, the rest all sent back.

units.zh: 辛亥，揭天下三司官姓名於奉天門西序。
units.en: On xinhai the names of every provincial commissioner were displayed on the west side of Chengtian Gate.
units.literal: On xinhai names of officials of the three provincial commissions were posted at the west corridor of Chengtian Gate.

units.zh: 癸丑，免被災稅糧。
units.en: On guichou grain levies in disaster districts were forgiven.
units.literal: On guichou disaster-struck grain taxes were remitted.

units.zh: 庚申，葬文皇帝於長陵。
units.en: On gengshen the late Chengzu was interred at Changling.
units.literal: On gengshen the Cultural Emperor was buried at Changling.

units.zh: 丙寅，鎮遠侯顧興祖破平樂、潯州蠻。
units.en: On bingyin Zhenyuan Marquis Gu Xingzu crushed the rebels of Pingle and Xunzhou.
units.literal: On bingyin Gu Xingzu Marquis of Zhenyuan broke the Pingle and Xunzhou tribes.

units.zh: 是年，丁闐、琉球、占城、哈密、古麻剌朗、滿剌加、蘇祿、瓦剌入貢。
units.en: That year tributes arrived from Diantan, Ryukyu, Champa, Hami, Kamalolang, Melaka, Sulu, and the Oirat.
units.literal: That year, Diantan, Liuqiu, Champa, Hami, Kamalolang, Melaka, Sulu, Oirats came to offer tribute.

units.zh: 洪熙元年春正月壬申朔，御奉天門受朝，不舉樂。
units.en: In the first year of Hongxi, on the new moon of renshen in the first month of spring, he held court at Fengtian Gate without music.
units.literal: Hongxi year one, spring, first month, renshen new moon, he received court at Fengtian Gate, music not performed.

units.zh: 乙亥，敕內外羣臣修舉職業。
units.en: On yihai the throne ordered every minister, at court and in the provinces, to perform his office with care.
units.literal: On the day yihai, an edict charged officials within and without the court to attend diligently to their duties.

units.zh: 己卯，享太廟。
units.en: On jimao he sacrificed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
units.literal: On the day jimao, he offered sacrifice at the Great Temple.

units.zh: 建弘文閣，命儒臣入直，楊溥掌閣事。
units.en: The Hongwen Pavilion was built; scholar-officials were posted there in rotation, with Yang Pu as director.
units.literal: The Hongwen Pavilion was established; Confucian scholars were ordered to attend in rotation, with Yang Pu as director of the pavilion.

units.zh: 癸未，以時雪不降，敕羣臣修省。
units.en: On guiwei, with no seasonable snow, the Emperor charged his ministers to examine themselves and reform.
units.literal: On the day guiwei, because timely snow had not fallen, the emperor charged the ministers to examine themselves and reform.

units.zh: 丙戌，大祀天地於南郊。
units.en: On bingxu he offered the great suburban sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.
units.literal: On the day bingxu, he performed the great sacrifice to Heaven and Earth at the Southern Suburb.

units.zh: 奉太祖、太宗配。
units.en: Taizu and Taizong were joined in the rite as corollary spirits.
units.literal: Taizu and Taizong were enshrined as corollary spirits.

units.zh: 壬辰，朝臣予告歸省者賜鈔有差，著為令。
units.en: On renchen, officials on leave to visit their families were granted paper money in graded sums, and the practice was written into law.
units.literal: On the day renchen, officials granted leave to return home received paper money in graded amounts; this was codified as regulation.

units.zh: 己亥，布政使周幹、按察使胡概、參政葉春巡視南畿、浙江。
units.en: On jihai, Zhou Gan, Hu Gai, and Ye Chun were sent as administration, surveillance, and vice commissioners to inspect the Southern Capital districts and Zhejiang.
units.literal: On the day jihai, Provincial Administration Commissioner Zhou Gan, Surveillance Commissioner Hu Gai, and Administration Vice Commissioner Ye Chun were sent to inspect the Southern Capital region and Zhejiang.

units.zh: 二月辛丑，頒將軍印於諸邊將。
units.en: In the second month, on xinchou, general's seals were distributed to frontier commanders.
units.literal: In the second month, on the day xinchou, general's seals were issued to frontier commanders.

units.zh: 戊申，祭社稷。
units.en: On wushen he sacrificed to the altars of soil and grain.
units.literal: On the day wushen, he sacrificed to the altars of soil and grain.

units.zh: 命太監鄭和守備南京。
units.en: The eunuch Zheng He was ordered to garrison Nanjing.
units.literal: The eunuch Zheng He was ordered to defend Nanjing.

units.zh: 丙辰，耕耤田。
units.en: On bingchen he plowed the sacred field.
units.literal: On the day bingchen, he plowed the sacred field.

units.zh: 丙寅，太宗神主祔太廟。
units.en: On bingyin Taizong's spirit tablet was installed in the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
units.literal: On the day bingyin, Taizong's spirit tablet was enshrined in the Great Temple.

units.zh: 是月，南京地屢震。
units.en: That month the earth in Nanjing shook again and again.
units.literal: That month, the ground in Nanjing shook repeatedly.

units.zh: 三月壬申，前光祿署丞權謹以孝行擢文華殿大學士。
units.en: In the third month, on renshen, Quan Jin, former assistant director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, was raised to Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall for filial devotion.
units.literal: In the third month, on the day renshen, the former Assistant Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments Quan Jin was raised to Grand Secretary of the Wenhua Hall for filial conduct.

units.zh: 丁丑，求直言。
units.en: On dingchou the court called for blunt counsel.
units.literal: On the day dingchou, blunt counsel was solicited.

units.zh: 戊子，隆平饑，戶部請以官麥貸之。
units.en: On wuzi Longping was in famine; the Ministry of Revenue asked to lend out government grain.
units.literal: On the day wuzi, Longping suffered famine; the Ministry of Revenue asked to lend government grain.

units.zh: 帝曰：「即振之，何貸為。」
units.en: The Emperor said, "Relieve them at once—why lend?"
units.literal: The Emperor said: "Relieve them at once—why lend?"

units.zh: 己丑，詔曰：「刑者所以禁暴止邪，導民於善，非務誅殺也。
units.en: On jichou an edict declared, "Punishment exists to curb violence, stop evil, and guide the people toward good—not to pursue killing for its own sake.
units.literal: On the day jichou, an edict said: "Punishment is meant to restrain violence, halt wickedness, and lead the people toward goodness—not to aim at killing.

units.zh: 吏或深文傅會，以致冤濫，朕深憫之。
units.en: Sometimes officials twist the law and stitch cases together until the innocent are swept up; We pity this deeply.
units.literal: Officials sometimes twist the statutes and force cases together until injustice spreads; We deeply pity this.

units.zh: 自今其悉依律擬罪。
units.en: From this day forward let every sentence follow the code alone.
units.literal: From now on let all punishments be gauged strictly according to law.

units.zh: 或朕過於嫉惡，法外用刑，法司執奏，。
units.en: If We grow too harsh and punish outside the law, let the judicial offices remonstrate.
units.literal: If We are overly severe and impose punishment outside the code, let the judicial offices remonstrate.

units.zh: 五奏不允，同三公、大臣執奏，必允乃已。
units.en: If We refuse five times, let the Three Excellencies and the chief ministers remonstrate together; only when We yield may they stop.
units.literal: If after five memorials We still refuse, let the Three Excellencies and senior ministers remonstrate jointly; only when We assent may they desist.

units.zh: 諸司不得鞭囚背及加入宮刑。
units.en: No office may flog a prisoner's back or add palace castration.
units.literal: All offices are forbidden to flog prisoners' backs or add palace castration.

units.zh: 有自宮者以不孝論。
units.en: Whoever castrates himself shall be judged unfilial.
units.literal: Whoever castrates himself shall be judged unfilial.

units.zh: 非謀反。
units.en: Save in cases of treason,
units.literal: Save for treason,

units.zh: 勿連坐親屬。
units.en: do not punish kin by association.
units.literal: do not punish kin by association.

units.zh: 古之盛世，采聽民言，用資戒儆。
units.en: In the golden ages of old, rulers gathered and heeded the people's words to warn themselves.
units.literal: In antiquity's golden ages rulers gathered and heeded the people's words to warn themselves.

units.zh: 今奸人往往摭拾，誣為誹謗，法吏刻深，鍛練成獄。
units.en: Now villains pick up stray words and call them slander, and harsh magistrates forge cases until men are condemned.
units.literal: Now scoundrels often pick up stray words and call them slander; harsh magistrates hammer cases until men are convicted.

units.zh: 刑之不中，民則無措，其餘誹謗禁，有告者一切勿治。」
units.en: When punishment misses the mark the people have nowhere to turn; as for the remaining bans on slander, any who bring such charges are not to be heard."
units.literal: When punishment misses the mark the people are at a loss; as for the rest of the prohibitions on slander, any who report them are not to be entertained."

units.zh: 庚寅，陽武侯薛祿為鎮朔大將軍，率師巡開平、大同邊。
units.en: On gengyin Xue Lu, Marquis of Yangwu, was made General Who Pacifies the North and led troops to patrol the Kaiping and Datong frontiers.
units.literal: On the day gengyin, Marquis of Yangwu Xue Lu was made General Who Pacifies the North and led troops to patrol the Kaiping and Datong frontiers.

units.zh: 辛卯，參將安平伯李安與榮昌伯陳智同鎮交阯。
units.en: On xinmao Li An, Earl of Anping and regional vice commander, and Chen Zhi, Earl of Rongchang, were jointly assigned to guard Jiaozhi.
units.literal: On the day xinmao, Regional Vice Commander Earl of Anping Li An and Earl of Rongchang Chen Zhi were jointly assigned to guard Jiaozhi.

units.zh: 戊戌，將還都南京，詔北京諸司悉稱行在，復北京行部及行後軍都督府。
units.en: On wuxu, as the court prepared to move the capital back to Nanjing, an edict renamed all Beijing offices the traveling court and restored the traveling ministries and the traveling Rear Military Commission at Beijing.
units.literal: On the day wuxu, as the court prepared to return the capital to Nanjing, an edict ordered all Beijing agencies to be called the traveling court, and restored the traveling ministries and traveling Rear Military Commission at Beijing.

units.zh: 是月，南京地屢震。
units.en: That month the earth in Nanjing shook again and again.
units.literal: That month, the ground in Nanjing shook repeatedly.

units.zh: 夏四月壬寅，帝聞山東及淮、徐民乏食，有司徵夏稅方急，乃御西角門詔大學士楊士奇草詔，免今年夏稅及科糧之半。
units.en: In summer, the fourth month, on renyin, the Emperor learned that Shandong and the Huai and Xu regions were short of food while local officials were pressing summer taxes hard; he went to the West Corner Gate, had Grand Secretary Yang Shiqi draft an edict, and remitted this year's summer tax and half the levy grain.
units.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on the day renyin, the Emperor heard that the people of Shandong and the Huai and Xu regions lacked food while officials were pressing summer taxes; he went to the West Corner Gate, ordered Grand Secretary Yang Shiqi to draft an edict, and remitted this year's summer tax and half the levy grain.

units.zh: 士奇言：「上恩至矣，但須戶、工二部預聞。」
units.en: Shiqi said, "Your grace is boundless—but the Ministries of Revenue and Works ought to be told beforehand."
units.literal: Shiqi said: "Your grace is complete—but the Ministries of Revenue and Works should be forewarned."

units.zh: 帝曰：「救民之窮當如救焚拯溺，不可遲疑。
units.en: The Emperor said, "To save the people from want is like snatching them from fire or water; there must be no delay.
units.literal: The Emperor said: "To rescue the people from want is like snatching them from fire or drowning; there must be no delay.

units.zh: 有司慮國用不足，必持不決之意。」
units.en: The clerks will fret over the treasury and drag their feet."
units.literal: The officials will fret over the treasury and withhold action."

units.zh: 趣命中官具楮筆，令士奇就門樓書詔。
units.en: He hurriedly ordered a palace eunuch to bring paper and brush and told Shiqi to write the edict on the gate tower.
units.literal: He hurriedly ordered a palace eunuch to bring paper and brush and told Shiqi to write the edict on the gate tower.

units.zh: 帝覽畢，即用璽付外行之。
units.en: The Emperor read it, sealed it at once, and sent it out to be promulgated.
units.literal: When the Emperor had read it he sealed it at once and sent it out to be promulgated.

units.zh: 顧士奇曰：「今可語部臣矣。」
units.en: Turning to Shiqi he said, "Now you may tell the ministries."
units.literal: Turning to Shiqi he said: "Now you may inform the ministries."

units.zh: 設北京行都察院。
units.en: The traveling Censorate was established at Beijing.
units.literal: The traveling Censorate was established at Beijing.

units.zh: 壬子，命皇太子謁孝陵，遂居守南京。
units.en: On renzi the Crown Prince was ordered to pay homage at Xiaoling and then remain to guard Nanjing.
units.literal: On the day renzi, the Crown Prince was ordered to pay homage at Xiaoling and then remain to guard Nanjing.

units.zh: 戊午，如天壽山，謁長陵。
units.en: On wuwu the Emperor went to Tianshou Mountain and paid homage at Changling.
units.literal: On the day wuwu, the Emperor went to Tianshou Mountain and paid homage at Changling.

units.zh: 己未，還宮。
units.en: On jiwei he returned to the palace.
units.literal: On the day jiwei, he returned to the palace.

units.zh: 是月，振河南及大名饑。
units.en: That month relief was sent for famine in Henan and Daming.
units.literal: That month, relief was distributed for famine in Henan and Daming.

units.zh: 南京地屢震。
units.en: The earth in Nanjing shook again and again.
units.literal: The ground in Nanjing shook repeatedly.

units.zh: 五月己卯，侍讀李時勉、侍講羅汝敬以言事改御史，尋下獄。
units.en: In the fifth month, on jimao, Lecturer Li Shimian and Reader-Expounder Luo Rujing were demoted to censor posts for speaking out on state affairs, and soon were thrown into prison.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the day jimao, Lecturer Li Shimian and Reader-Expounder Luo Rujing were transferred to censor posts for memorializing on affairs of state, and soon were imprisoned.

units.zh: 庚辰，帝不豫，遣使召皇太子於南京。
units.en: On gengchen the Emperor fell ill and sent envoys to summon the Crown Prince from Nanjing.
units.literal: On the day gengchen, the Emperor fell ill and sent envoys to summon the Crown Prince from Nanjing.

units.zh: 辛巳，大漸，遺詔傳位皇太子。
units.en: On xinsi his illness turned critical; his final testament passed the throne to the Crown Prince.
units.literal: On the day xinsi, his illness became critical; his final testament passed the throne to the Crown Prince.

units.zh: 是日，崩於飲安殿，年四十有八。
units.en: That same day he died in the Hall of Restful Tranquility, aged forty-eight.
units.literal: That same day he died in the Hall of Restful Tranquility, aged forty-eight.

units.zh: 秋七月己巳，上尊諡，廟號仁宗，葬獻陵。
units.en: In autumn, the seventh month, on jisi, posthumous titles were raised; his temple name was Renzong, and he was buried at Xianling.
units.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the day jisi, posthumous titles were raised; his temple name was Renzong, and he was buried at Xianling.

units.zh: 贊曰：「當靖難師起，仁宗以世子居守，全城濟師。
units.en: The eulogy says, "When the armies of the pacification rose, Renzong as heir apparent held the city, kept it whole, and fed the host.
units.literal: The eulogy says: "When the troops of the pacification of troubles rose, Renzong as heir apparent held the city, preserved it whole, and succored the army.

units.zh: 其後成祖乘輿，歲出北征，東宮監國，朝無廢事。
units.en: Afterward, when Chengzu took the field and campaigned north year after year, the Eastern Palace governed the realm and the court knew no neglect.
units.literal: Afterward, when Chengzu took the field and campaigned north year upon year, the Eastern Palace governed the realm and the court knew no neglect.

units.zh: 然中遘媒孽，瀕於危疑者屢矣，而終以誠敬獲全。
units.en: Yet he met slanderers again and again and often stood on the brink of ruin—yet in the end sincerity and reverence preserved him.
units.literal: Yet he met slanderers time and again and often stood on the brink of peril—yet in the end sincerity and reverence preserved him.

units.zh: 善乎其告人曰「吾知盡子職而已，不知有讒人也」，是可為萬世子臣之法矣。
units.en: How apt his words to others: 'I know only to fulfill a son's duty; I do not know that there are slanderers'—a model for sons and ministers through ten thousand ages.
units.literal: How apt his saying to others: 'I know only to fulfill a son's duty; I do not know that there are slanderers'—this may serve as the model for sons and ministers through ten thousand ages.

units.zh: 在位一載。
units.en: He reigned one year.
units.literal: He reigned one year.

units.zh: 用人行政，善不勝書。
units.en: In appointing men and ordering the state, his good deeds could not all be recorded.
units.literal: In appointing men and ordering the state, his good deeds could not all be recorded.

units.zh: 使天假之年，涵濡休養，德化之盛，豈不與文、景比隆哉。」
units.en: Had Heaven granted him more years to nurture and restore the people, would not the fullness of his moral sway have rivaled the glory of the Wen and Jing reigns?"
units.literal: Had Heaven granted him more years to nurture and restore the people, would not the fullness of his moral sway have rivaled the glory of the Wen and Jing reigns?"
